title: Register R User-Defined Functions in DuckDB
text: Rducks registers R functions DuckDB SQL functions. ships R package plus DuckDB extension. UDF inputs outputs move explicit execution plans: arrow_r: reference path using DuckDB Arrow C Data plus nanoarrow/R. arrow_c: native extension path supported scalar vectorized calls. arrow_ipc: process-isolated path using Arrow IPC request/result payloads generic Future backend. user-facing UDF semantics separate execution plan: mode = "scalar" means one R call per logical row; mode = "vectorized" means one R call per DuckDB chunk.

title: Register R User-Defined Functions in DuckDB
text: rducks_register() returns rducks_registration object records connection, normalized signature, registration options. need keep object UDF keep working DuckDB.
code: library(DBI) library(duckdb) library(Rducks)  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(config = list(allow_unsigned_extensions = "true"))) rducks_enable(con, threads = "single")  reg_plus_one <- rducks_register(   con,   name = "r_plus_one",   fun = function(x) x + 1,   args = DOUBLE,   returns = DOUBLE,   mode = "scalar" )  dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT r_plus_one(41.0) AS x") #>    x #> 1 42

title: Register R User-Defined Functions in DuckDB
text: Scalar mode calls R function per DuckDB row. Vectorized mode calls R function per DuckDB chunk one R vector/list-column per declared argument. vectorized mode, null_handling = "default" evaluates rows top-level SQL NULL inputs scatters SQL NULLs back result. null_handling = "special" passes rows using NA/NULL shapes scalar mode. return length must match number evaluated rows. Vectorized mode currently requires least one declared argument. tiny benchmark bench can show call-shape difference simple R work. result illustrative rather performance guarantee.
code: reg_vec_plus_one <- rducks_register(   con,   name = "r_vec_plus_one",   fun = function(x) x + 1,   args = DOUBLE,   returns = DOUBLE,   mode = "vectorized",   side_effects = TRUE )  dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT sum(r_vec_plus_one(i::DOUBLE)) AS x FROM range(5) AS t(i)") #>    x #> 1 15 bench_n <- 10000L bench_result <- bench::mark(   scalar = DBI::dbGetQuery(     con,     sprintf("SELECT sum(r_plus_one(i::DOUBLE)) AS x FROM range(%d) AS t(i)", bench_n)   ),   vectorized = DBI::dbGetQuery(     con,     sprintf("SELECT sum(r_vec_plus_one(i::DOUBLE)) AS x FROM range(%d) AS t(i)", bench_n)   ),   iterations = 3,   check = FALSE ) bench_result[, c("expression", "median", "itr/sec", "mem_alloc")] #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   expression   median `itr/sec` mem_alloc #>   <bch:expr> <bch:tm>     <dbl> <bch:byt> #> 1 scalar        296ms      3.38    1.97MB #> 2 vectorized    240ms      4.15    2.34MB

title: Register R User-Defined Functions in DuckDB
text: Register UDFs registration-safe configuration. call rducks_enable_inproc() switch query execution explicit -process queue. liveness scheduling feature -process callbacks; still serializes R API work recorded R lane. DuckDB interprets external_threads threads supplied caller rather DuckDB-created worker threads. stress tests, prefer settings threads = 4, external_threads = 1; set external_threads = threads unless intentionally want DuckDB-created worker pool.
code: reg_sleepy <- rducks_register(   con,   name = "r_sleepy_time",   fun = function(x) {     Sys.sleep(0.001)     Sys.time()   },   args = DOUBLE,   returns = TIMESTAMP,   side_effects = TRUE )  rducks_enable_inproc(con)  rducks_inproc_self_test(con, 3) #> [1] 3 rducks_inproc_stats(con) #>   submitted executed timeouts #> 1         3        3        0  dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT r_sleepy_time(1.0) AS x") #>                     x #> 1 2026-05-04 21:18:06 rducks_inproc_stats(con) #>   submitted executed timeouts #> 1         4        4        0  rducks_disable_inproc(con, threads = 1)

title: Rducks 0.0.0.9000
text: Added arrow_ipc + multiprocess_parallel UDF path using generic future backends Arrow IPC task/result payloads. Scalar registrations loop rows inside worker, vectorized registrations call per chunk, queued native path splits submit collect phases multiple queued chunk tasks can outstanding results collected DuckDB provides concurrent UDF callbacks. rducks_explain_udf() now reports RIPC collect batch counters diagnosing whether chunks actually overlapping. Added internal %||% compatibility shim package works lowered R 4.3 dependency floor. Implemented arrow_c + vectorized registrations serial inproc_concurrent execution plans. native evaluator token RCV, rducks_explain_udf() reports arrow_c counters chunk calls. Added rducks_explain_udf() rducks_list_udfs() native per-UDF execution counters users can inspect registration metadata verify arrow_r/arrow_c chunks ran requested evaluator without fallback. Added R-universe badge README lowered package R dependency floor R 4.3. Added wasm/webR build detection configure, including DuckDB wasm metadata platform explicit Emscripten export extension entrypoint, plus Dockerfile.webr-test helper local rwasm builds. Added explicit execution-plan helpers rducks_execution_plan(), rducks_set_execution_plan(), rducks_current_execution_plan() separate UDF semantics connection-level marshalling/concurrency policy. arrow_r + serial plan reference implementation; arrow_c + vectorized planned arrow_ipc + multiprocess_parallel execution now fail explicitly plan validation rather silently falling back. Removed per-registration evaluator selection rducks_register(). evaluator now derived active execution plan, conformance tests compare plan-native registrations instead mixing evaluator choices inside single registration call. Added mode = "vectorized" R UDFs called per DuckDB chunk vector/list-column arguments. vectorized adapter uses Arrow C Data/nanoarrow bridge scalar mode, enforces return length, defines default vs special NULL handling, covered runtime tests. Added official -process queued execution API scalar UDFs: rducks_enable_inproc(), rducks_disable_inproc(), rducks_inproc_stats(), rducks_inproc_self_test(). backend keeps R API work recorded main R thread uses extension-owned queue timeout/error paths rather package-side pump hidden progress callback. Added native queue diagnostics tests covering main-lane queue draining scalar UDF execution queued path. Split scalar execution native extension runtime state UDF metadata uses DuckDB C extension bind/init/local-state hooks per-loaded-database runtime entries instead singleton connection. Initial development scaffold R package DuckDB extension bridge R user-defined functions.
